I remember when “Something“ first came out that Paul’s bass line is what really stood out to me. That and the beautiful harmony between George and Paul throughout the song made it a truly special song that grabbed the listener’s attention. 

Interestingly, I also read that George wanted more of a plain bass guitar part for the song and admonished Paul for going overboard with it. Glad Paul got his way. Lol…I think it literally MADE the song! 😏
